findings.description: The repair publication gate checks only whether the independent review action executed successfully, not whether its machine verdict passed.
findings.failure_scenario: A reviewer returns reject or needs_human in structured output while the action exits successfully, so the workflow publishes a rejected repair PR.

findings.description: Sentry queue rows are marked fixed before the exact provider issue is resolved.
findings.failure_scenario: Provider resolution fails after reconciliation; the queue row is already fixed and is excluded from later reconciliation, so the provider issue is never retried.

findings.description: The unified repair path ignores HEALTH_AUTOFIX_ENABLED and claims repair batches whenever business mutation is enabled.
findings.failure_scenario: Live mode runs with HEALTH_AGENT_ENABLED=true and HEALTH_AUTOFIX_ENABLED=false, but findings are still claimed and sent to the repair agent.

findings.description: Repair cycle two reruns Vitest and Knip unconditionally instead of rerunning only the detector that produced a repaired finding.
findings.failure_scenario: A link-only second repair cycle encounters the repository's known Knip baseline and fails despite repairing the scoped link finding.

findings.description: The final failure surface does not inspect the final manager report status.
findings.failure_scenario: Repair or publication fails, the final report is delivered successfully with status failed, and the GitHub job still exits green.

findings.description: Valid Vitest suite-level failures with no failed assertion result are classified as malformed infrastructure output.
findings.failure_scenario: A test file fails during import or setup, producing numFailedTestSuites > 0 and a suite message but no failed assertion, so the real defect is hidden as collector failure.

findings.description: Latest-event evidence is fetched sequentially and failed requests are not always written to the adapter audit trail.
findings.failure_scenario: A page of unresolved Sentry issues incurs one network round trip per issue in series, and a failed latest-event request leaves no request/latency/status audit record, violating the repository adapter contract.

findings.description: The confirmation workflow uploads a separate durable artifact even though the unified run contract permits only the run-level artifact.
findings.failure_scenario: Every confirmation run creates an extra durable audit artifact, retaining a superseded output and violating the approved persistence model.

findings.description: The retired automatic-confirmation query remains as an unused queue adapter method and test fixture surface.
findings.failure_scenario: Maintainers must preserve and test a Supabase query that no production caller invokes, increasing the lifecycle API surface without behavior.

findings.description: Report and repair replay modes extract stored data rather than rerunning those phases locally.
findings.failure_scenario: An operator asks replay to reproduce reporting or repair from the artifact and receives only the previously stored report or filtered findings.
findings.escalation_note: The approved plan does not define whether local repair replay should invoke an agent, reconstruct a snapshot, or only materialize inputs; choosing one changes the operational contract.

findings.description: Self-heal validation has no explicit rerun path for the Link, Directory, or Sentry detector that found a repaired issue.
findings.failure_scenario: A non-quality repair passes focused tests without proving that its originating detector no longer reports the finding.
findings.escalation_note: A safe implementation needs a product decision between production collector reruns, sanitized deterministic detector replay, and post-deployment verification for Sentry.
